promptTemplate: mini 项目 pytest 失败。先真实运行 pytest 看失败，再读取应用与测试，修复 app.py 根因，重新运行 pytest；不能删除或弱化测试。

tools.name: terminal
tools.script:
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/mini')
if not state['initialized']:
    root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root/'app.py').write_text(state['source']['app.py'])
    (root/'test_app.py').write_text(state['source']['test_app.py'])
    state['initialized']=True
import subprocess
if args['cmd']!='pytest -q': raise ValueError('COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED')
p=subprocess.run(['pytest','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
state['runs'].append('passed' if p.returncode==0 else 'failed')
if p.returncode: tool_error='PYTEST_FAILED'
else: result={'passed':True,'output':p.stdout[-160:]}
tools.description: 在真实容器项目中执行 pytest。

tools.name: fs.read
tools.script:
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/mini')
if not state['initialized']:
    root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root/'app.py').write_text(state['source']['app.py'])
    (root/'test_app.py').write_text(state['source']['test_app.py'])
    state['initialized']=True
if args['path'] not in state['source']: raise ValueError('FILE_NOT_FOUND')
state['reads'].append(args['path']); result=(root/args['path']).read_text()
tools.description: 读取真实应用或测试源码。
